top_signals.title: FBI Epstein Emails Show Sarah Ferguson Reached Patel
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg News Senior Investigative Reporter writes a weekly newsletter, The FOIA Files. This week's edition show "records, which include emails, spreadsheets and training slides, provide a window into the internal deliberations at the highest levels of government as officials discussed how to review, redact and release the Epstein files." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
